description: This file defines the PDO class within the Opencart \\System\\Library\\DB namespace. It provides an object-oriented wrapper around PHP's PDO for database interactions specific to the OpenCart project. The class manages database connection setup, query execution with prepared statements, escaping parameters, and retrieving information such as last insert ID and affected rows.

classes.name: PDO
classes.description: A custom wrapper class for PHP's PDO tailored for OpenCart, managing database connections, queries, and related operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection using provided options, sets session variables, and handles connection errors.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs SQL queries with prepared statements and returns result objects or booleans.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Creates a named parameter placeholder for safely binding SQL parameters.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last write operation.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the auto-increment ID generated by the last insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection upon object destruction.
